recordedButNotRendered.note: The registry does state the following about this filing. It is recorded here so nothing is lost, and it is deliberately not rendered into any document, caption, allegation or instruction.
recordedButNotRendered.venue: The court where the charges were brought or the trial was held, or the court with jurisdiction over the violation for a deferral participant. Filed under the original cause number, or as an MC case type if no cause number was assigned.
recordedButNotRendered.feeWaiver: Not applicable. There is no fee.
recordedButNotRendered.participantSignature: The petition is verified and signed by the petitioner.
recordedButNotRendered.service: Service on the prosecuting attorney. Confirm local practice on the MC case-type assignment.
recordedButNotRendered.notice: Service on the prosecuting attorney, who has thirty days to file a notice in opposition. The court may summarily grant, set a hearing, or summarily deny. A hearing is required if opposition is filed and the court does not rule summarily.
recordedButNotRendered.manualCompletionItem: Verification and signature - Petition, verification block. The participant signs it themselves once stage 2 becomes available.
